purpose: Connect verified commercial orders to jobs, loads, journeys, delivery evidence and invoice readiness without inventing financial or operational facts.
rules: A missing POD cannot be represented as verified delivery evidence.
An invoice may become READY only when configured commercial and delivery prerequisites are verified.
A payment cannot be marked PAID without a verified payment signal.
A single unverified signal cannot create a financial exception.
Safety or security holds cannot be overridden merely to accelerate revenue recognition.
Conflicting verified signals require human review.
Insufficient live data produces UNAVAILABLE rather than an invented state.
